Food

What the tavern serves

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Ofto kleftiko

Cooked in a traditional oven and served with pourgouri. One guest calls it fall-off-the-bone tender.

From the grill

Chicken and meat from the grill, with chips and pitta. One guest calls the chicken as tender as it gets.

Terrace and takeaway

Tables on the covered terrace along the street. The Facebook page lists dine-in, takeout and outdoor seating.

From the tavern

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Atmosphere

11 Google reviews mention the atmosphere, 3 call it a family tavern. One guest calls it warm and welcoming.

The food

10 reviews mention the food, 2 call it tasty. One guest calls it the number one place to eat in Nicosia.

Easy to miss

One guest writes that the tavern is small and easy to miss, but perfect. 3 reviews mention the value.

On Agiou Pavlou

At Agiou Pavlou 142 in Agios Dometios, with the covered terrace. For the opening hours and to book a table, call 22 777715.
